about_short_description.short_description: Milk Video is a platform that turns your webinar into video highlights.

product.name: Milk Video Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform that converts webinars and long-form video content into short, captioned video highlights for social media and marketing use.

product.name: Video Testimonial Creation
product.description: A service within the platform that enables collection, editing, and transformation of customer testimonial videos and audio into shareable clips and audiograms.

product.name: Video Ad Builder
product.description: A tool that assembles video ads from pre-built templates and building blocks like captions, brand assets, and waveforms through drag-and-drop editing.

product.name: Automatic Transcription and Captioning
product.description: An automated feature that transcribes video and audio content to generate accurate captions for videos.
